tool_args.rationale: The pilot spans the target horizon and has adequate gradient coverage. The remaining ambiguity is in the coupled transient: acquire the trajectory batch to bring the fit to at least eight observations and better separate the fast memory timescale from coupling before fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter siphon-memory ODE now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five endpoint observations leave no residual degrees of freedom and give limited leverage to distinguish the fast memory timescale from coupling strength.

considered_alternatives.option: Uncoupled Kelvin–Voigt creep or damped oscillator
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Neither model accounts for the observed sink-gradient and history-dependent lag signatures.
It does not provide trajectory observations that constrain the coupled transient.
